outline: 本課程教授現代人工智慧及機器學習之實務應用。課程內容教授程式設計搭配實務應用實例。提供學生學習資料分析與處理的基本技巧，包括數據模型、視覺化處理及實例應用之探討。
schedule:
This course teaches practical applications of modern artificial intelligence and machine learning. The course content includes programming combined with hands-on examples, providing students with essential data analysis and processing skills.
Week 1: Course Outlines & Logistics
Week 2: Holiday (228 Memorial Day)
Week 3: Introduction to Data Science
Week 4: Math & Statistics
Week 5-7: Modern AI & Machine Learning (I)
Week 8-10: Modern AI & Machine Learning (II)
Week 11: Midterm Review
Week 12-14: Python Programming & Industrial Applications in Data Analysis
Week 15-17: R Programming & Industrial Applications in Data Analysis
Week 18: Project Presentation and Discussion
materials:
1. Data Science Bookcamp: Five real-world Python projects, by Leonard Apeltsin, 2021.
2. R for Data Analysis in Easy Steps, 2nd edition, by Mike McGrath, 2023.
